rights_basis: The selected images are original maintainer-generated media. The repository owner explicitly authorized publishing representative computer-generated images on the GitHub homepage.

inventory.scan_scope: All PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP files in the local generated-images archive were read for format, dimensions and SHA-256. This is a complete file inventory, not a claim that 2,819 images received individual aesthetic approval.
inventory.selection_rule: Reuse only an original image with an explicit provenance and prior internal QA record when its isolated crop still represents the current Skill. Otherwise create a new image from the current Skill's observable camera, light, color, space, material and negative constraints.
inventory.selection_result: Two prior original atlas panels were reused; seven categories were newly generated because no prior image was sufficiently isolated, current-Skill-specific and public-ready. All nine final exports received a visible internal audit.
